sentences.text: Jing Tian -LRB- born July 21 , 1988 -RRB- is a Chinese actress .
She graduated from the Beijing Dance Academy and Beijing Film Academy .	Beijing Dance Academy	Beijing Dance Academy	Beijing Film Academy	Beijing Film Academy
She is known for her roles in The Warring States , Special ID , and Police Story 2013 .	The Warring States	The Warring States (film)	Special ID	Special ID	Police Story 2013	Police Story 2013

She is part of the cast for three Legendary Pictures films , 2016 's The Great Wall , 2017 's Kong : Skull Island , and the upcoming Pacific Rim : Uprising .	Legendary Pictures	Legendary Pictures	The Great Wall	The Great Wall (film)
